title: Note explicitly somewhere that all profile information is public on the internet
body: I think at one point we were intending to implement something in the way of privacy controls, but those aren't going to exist at launch; right now, if it's on the site, it's public. So this should probably be stated explicitly at the point where information is entered. Unless people think it's already sufficiently obvious from the UI?
author: Participant 1
